rationale: Decision: submit the iteration-10 design exactly as it raced (score 374.386), with no further change. The authorized entity1 text lists kd 0.25 and line_loss 'search_left' with base_speed 1.3. Those values do not match the scored record, which shows kd 0.35 and line_loss 'last_direction' for iteration 10. I keep the scored record, because the score is only attributable to the values that actually raced. The draft's geometry (8 mm sensors, body 0.12 x 0.12 m, mass 0.6 kg, track 0.10 m) and its base_speed 1.1 were never raced, so I reject them. Evidence: iteration 10 finished 20 of 20 oval runs (mean progress 0.998, mean time 1.88 s, score 950 per oval run). Its s-bend (progress 0.318) and slalom (progress 0.103) still leave the tape, with about 1 line-loss event per run. Iterations 8 and 9 reproduced the same design to four decimals, so the result is deterministic. The score depends heavily on the oval. The held-back track is of unknown shape, so the 374 figure may not transfer, and I do not claim bend-track gains. Kept: body 0.18 x 0.12 m, mass 0.8 kg, wheel_track 0.12 m, wheel_radius 0.03 m, five 12 mm sensors at x = -0.02 to +0.02 m and y = 0.05 m, kp 2.0, ki 0.5, kd 0.35, base_speed 1.3, line_loss 'last_direction'. Expected result: oval completion 0.95 to 1.0, time about 1.9 s, s-bend progress about 0.32, slalom about 0.10.
